name: Maya Chen
headline: Making little things for a more colorful world.
short_description: Illustrator, slow-living enthusiast, and collector of little everyday wonders.
description:
BioPage demo · This is a fictional creator profile.

Hi, I’m Maya. I turn small observations into colorful illustrations, thoughtful objects, and stories worth slowing down for.

This is my little corner of the internet. Explore what I’m making, read my latest notes, or help keep the creative experiments going.
